name: Delicata Squash
siboNotes: Well-tolerated by most SIBO patients due to low fiber content and naturally low FODMAP profile. Cook thoroughly to improve digestibility.
preparationTips: Roast with skin on - it's edible and becomes tender when cooked
Cut in half lengthwise, scoop out seeds, then slice into half-moons
Steam or roast at 400°F for 15-20 minutes until tender
Season with low-FODMAP herbs like rosemary or thyme
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin A and beta-carotene
